dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I just had a brief look around. I quite like that hat on the coat rack... It's a nice color, and pretty stylish too.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I would've quite liked to try it on if this was a marketplace...

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: But since it probably counts as lost property, I'll have to be content to admire it from afar.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: I will show no mercy to anyone who threatens my companions.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: So, whatever evil dwells within this domain, you need not fear. My spear and my shield are at your command.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: That is my duty as guardian.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: At the core of any myth is a true story, but once a story comes to bear the hopes and dreams of an entire people, fantastical fictions inevitably become mixed in with the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: But in my view, the truth of our myths is not important. Still I will stride the golden sands, my heart yearning for the light of dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Whether with or without the blessing of the gods, I will always be the guardian who protects my people.
